prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: preliminary pixel-art character concept board for DARKLIGHT: REQUIEM, for visual approval, not a finished animation sheet.
Input images: Image 1 is a collage of FOUR photos of the SAME young adult man Fabio; this is the primary identity reference for facial structure, shoulder-length layered wavy dark-brown hair with side strands, serious expression, and natural athletic build. Image 2 is ONLY a pixel-art density, contour and topview RPG rendering reference; do NOT copy its short hair, moustache, age, ochre clothes or backpack.
Create an ORIGINAL gothic urban fantasy version of Fabio who remains recognizable from the supplied real photos. No beard or moustache. Light-to-medium skin as photographed, youthful face, straight eyebrows, natural jaw/chin/nose/lips. Hair should reach the shoulders, wavy and layered, not an exaggerated anime spike haircut. Naturally athletic proportions, no superhero hypertrophy.
Outfit identical in both variants: fitted black waist-length rock/goth jacket with discreet silver zipper hardware over a black shirt, dark trousers, black boots, small silver waist chain. Supernatural sword Requiem: original narrow straight steel blade with a thin deep-red central energy line, small angular dark hilt; modest silhouette, not a copy of any existing game weapon. Default sword held in anatomical right hand in a relaxed pose, unobscured grip, consistent across views.
Composition: one clean wide concept board with TWO complete full-body RPG-topview figures side by side, one without glasses and one wearing the black rectangular glasses from the lower-right real photo. TWO enlarged isolated head-and-shoulder pixel portraits above the matching bodies, also without/with glasses. Both variants must have exactly the same face and outfit, only glasses differ. Complete hair and boots, generous empty space between all four components, no cropping or overlaps.
Full-body camera matches the reference RPG topview, slightly viewed from above with front face and shoulders visible, NOT isometric, NOT a side-scroller. Compact game-like proportions, about four to five heads tall, maintaining adult athletic shoulders, no childish chibi silhouette. Portraits preserve photo likeness with larger readable pixel clusters.
Medium: intentional square-pixel art, dark clear contour, carefully grouped flat shadows, limited charcoal/black/cool gray/skin/dark-brown/deep-crimson palette, crisp pixel boundaries, no antialiasing, no painterly smoothing, no photorealistic texture. Portrait identity can be more detailed than the tiny game sprite. Emphasize dark-clothes silhouette readability through subtle gray edges.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, not a drawn checkerboard. No floor, ground, cast shadow, aura, fog, environment, labels, text, grid, watermark, or logo. No transformation traits, wings or silver hair. Only the requested character components.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: revised preliminary character concept board for DARKLIGHT: REQUIEM, awaiting visual approval.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing provisional concept board to EDIT. Image 2 is the user's real-photo collage, primary identity reference.
The user LIKED the preserved likeness and the beautiful shoulder-length wavy hair in Image 1. Preserve this person's specific facial identity, youthful clean-shaven serious face, nose/lips/jaw/eyebrow shape and the same dark-brown layered wavy hair. Preserve without-glasses and black-rectangular-glasses variants.
Apply these requested changes to BOTH complete full-body figures:
1) NATURAL ADULT HEAD-TO-BODY PROPORTIONS, around 6.5 to 7 heads tall. Reduce the oversize head relative to the body by about one-third; naturally athletic shoulders, chest, arms and legs, no chibi or caricature. Figures must not look like big-headed children.
2) Replace the short biker jacket with a LONG BLACK LEATHER OVERCOAT, reaching just below the knees, open front over black shirt and dark fitted trousers, black boots, discreet silver fasteners, tasteful subtle leather highlights, soft coat folds and two clear coat tails. GOTHIC/ROCK URBAN style, no military insignia and no costume copied from an existing game.
3) Replace the straight broad sword with an ORIGINAL elegant KATANA: slender distinctly CURVED single-edge steel blade, dark wrapped handle, small simple dark circular guard; subtle thin crimson supernatural line along the blade INSIDE the silhouette, no excessive glow. Hold in anatomical RIGHT hand, relaxed grip, whole blade visible.
4) Make the face LESS VISIBLY BLOCKY. The previous large square facial patches were too pixelated. Preserve face likeness but use smaller, subtler pixel clusters and cleaner facial shading; no exaggerated coarse mosaic. The enlarged portraits should be detailed stylized likeness studies, with gentle facial transitions and subtle pixel-art texture, not a heavily pixelated face and not photorealism. Full-body art remains usable as a design reference for a 2D game, with discrete pixels concentrated on contours/clothes rather than large square facial artifacts.
Composition: keep the same four-part approval board, two isolated detailed head-and-shoulder portraits across the top (no glasses / glasses), two matching COMPLETE full-body figures below (no glasses / glasses). Extend the full bodies into natural adult proportions rather than simply shrinking everything. Full overcoat hem, hands, katana tip and boots visible, no overlap.
Request a smaller overall source canvas, about 1024x1024, with the entire board carefully framed; reducing source size must not erase facial likeness or add big blocky facial pixels. Technical grid precision is not required for this concept.
Full-body view: mild RPG topview with top of shoulders/hair visible, front-facing natural standing pose. No isometric or side-scroller reinterpretation.
Colors: black leather, charcoal, subdued cool-gray highlights, natural skin and dark-brown hair, discreet crimson katana detail. Genuine TRANSPARENT alpha background. No background fill, floor, cast shadow, fog, external halo, text, labels, watermark, logo or extra figures. This is a DESIGN REVISION, not a transformation: no wings, silver hair or monster traits.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: actual GAME-LOOK 2D pixel-art neutral directional reference sheet for DARKLIGHT: REQUIEM, awaiting visual approval.
Input images: Image 1 is the latest concept board, the DESIGN to translate to pixel sprites. Image 2 is the user's four real photos, identity reference. Image 3 is the RPG topview game's style reference, for pixel/game appearance only; do not adopt its character identity or oversized head.
The user likes the face, hair, long black LEATHER OVERCOAT, curved KATANA and adult proportions from Image 1, but explicitly wants MORE PIXEL ART and a real 2D GAME look. Convert that design into genuinely LOW-RES GAME SPRITES, not tiny realistic paintings. Preserve the same young clean-shaven serious face, shoulder-length layered wavy dark-brown hair, anatomical RIGHT-hand katana and anatomical LEFT-hip silver chain. No glasses on this first sheet.
Body proportions: adult, around SIX to SEVEN heads tall. Head should remain proportional to the athletic adult body, never chibi or large-headed. Outfit: black leather overcoat open over black shirt and charcoal trousers, coat hem just below the knees, black boots, restrained silver hardware and subtle chain. Original curved narrow single-edge katana, black wrapped handle, small black round guard, narrow crimson accent IN the blade, held relaxed downward. Whole sword and feet visible.
Pixel language: intentionally authored SMALL SQUARE PIXEL CLUSTERS, body roughly 64-72 LOGICAL PIXELS tall with the head about 10-12 logical pixels high, hard stepped silhouettes, 1-pixel dark contours, two or three shades per material, LIMITED PALETTE around 24-32 colors, no smooth gradients. Hair waves in dark brown cluster shapes, readable coat silhouette, legible boots and katana. Crisp sprite shading, NOT painterly, NOT high-resolution realistic faces, NOT 3D render, NOT photographic leather noise. Display these low-resolution sprite designs enlarged with NEAREST-NEIGHBOR, each logical pixel visible as a square; avoid artificial compression/noise and random mosaic filters. Give the face restrained readable eyes/nose/mouth at this scale rather than generic anime eyes.
Layout: EXACTLY EIGHT full-body standing sprites, FOUR columns by TWO rows, evenly spaced in invisible equal-size cells, aligned foot baselines, ample transparent separation. Same actor scale and neutral pose across the sheet, different actual orientations, no walk cycle, portraits or extra figures.
TOP ROW LEFT TO RIGHT: SOUTH/front facing down toward the player; SOUTHWEST/three-quarter FRONT facing lower-left; WEST/profile facing LEFT; NORTHWEST/three-quarter BACK facing upper-left.
BOTTOM ROW LEFT TO RIGHT: NORTH/full BACK with no eyes or face visible; NORTHEAST/three-quarter BACK facing upper-right; EAST/profile facing RIGHT; SOUTHEAST/three-quarter FRONT facing lower-right.
Game camera: consistent RPG TOPVIEW, slightly elevated over the character with visible hair crown/shoulder tops and body front where appropriate. NOT isometric, not side-scroller, not straight overhead. Preserve anatomical right hand sword and left hip chain; do not mirror-swap them. Katana should rotate with the physical actor in each view and remain within its cell. Back views show the coat back and hair covering the neck, not faces.
TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background, no floor, shadow, glow, backdrop, checkerboard pixels, labels, text, watermark or grid. The entire result must read immediately as a sprite sheet from a 2D pixel-art game.

Edit the supplied approved 2D pixel art character reference sheet. Make one precise costume-detail change: add a short, subtle row of SMALL silver steel conical spikes to the shoulder panels of the black leather long coat, on both anatomical shoulders, consistent in all eight existing views according to perspective and hair occlusion. About 3 to 4 tiny studs/spikes on each visible shoulder, restrained size, narrow pointed metal cones with dark gray base and 1-pixel silvery highlight. They must look like small gothic rock leather jacket accessories, not armor or large fantasy pauldrons. Match existing crisp square pixel clusters, dark outlines, shading and pixel scale. Preserve the approved character's face, shoulder-length wavy brown hair, adult head/body proportions, expression, long black leather coat, katana, chain, boots, poses, existing direction order and exact 4 columns by 2 rows layout. Preserve all eight full bodies and blades without clipping. Do not redraw, redesign, enlarge heads or change the character. No text, labels, extra objects, extra characters, glow or painterly smoothing. Transparent background. Only change the shoulder spike detail.
